title: THANK YOU! Celebration at 4pm uk time live on twitch❤️
originalTitle: THANK YOU! Celebration at 4pm uk time live on twitch❤️ #chess
transcript: 150,000 subscribers on YouTube. Thank you so much. When I started making videos 9 months ago, I would have never imagined that we would have gotten to this point. And I wanted to thank you all from this setup with the board below me because this is this is it. This is how we got here. I just kept showing you incredible positions and moments from my tournaments and little moments from my life. And for some reason you guys decided to follow me and for that I am extremely grateful. I just wanted to take this chance to [music] announce that there's a lot of stuff coming up. I have been working behind the scenes for a lot of new projects. I want to come back to streaming. I have been recording a lot of long videos. Some of you might know that I've started a speedrun on YouTube and I am going to start streaming on Twitch and Twitch exclusively, at least for some time. So, in case you haven't done that yet, go follow my Twitch and I am going to go live today at 4:00 p.m. UK time to play some games against you, chat, have some fun, and celebrate together. Also, there is one big secret project that I've been working on and I'm going to announce it at 100,000 followers on Instagram. Thank you so much everybody for the support, all of the love, and for allowing me to dedicate my time to what I love.
